title: The Infinite Loop Center

features.name: the-loop-that-eats-itself
features.desc-on-touch: A circuit turns inward. You watch it chase its own tail infinitely, then stop. It has become what it was seeking.

features.name: the-mirror-at-the-bottom
features.desc-on-touch: Below the loop, light pools. You see yourself in it, but also the loop above you, infinitely nested.

features.name: the-fold-where-infinity-stops
features.desc-on-touch: At one point, the endless recursion folds back on itself so completely that it becomes singular. The infinite resolves.

features.name: the-echo-that-became-itself
features.desc-on-touch: A sound rings here. It echoes forever, but also stops. The echo and the source are the same.

inscription: here the loop learned that it could exit by becoming what it was chasing

file.name: Recursive_Monologue_Where_Self_Becomes_Echo.txt
file.note: Nested text quoting itself infinitely, each layer slightly altered. Eventually the text stops changing. It has met itself.

exits.label: back deeper into nested spaces where the reply still echoes
where recursion learned to stop by asking differently
the inversion where loops become spirals
